title: expert_invocations 降级链 (Redis→SQLite→file)
acceptance_criteria: node/src/core/expert-invocations-queue.ts implements 3-tier queue (L1 Redis → L2 SQLite → L3 file)
L1 → L2 fallback on Redis timeout
L2 → L3 fallback on SQLite error
notes: 借 EKET 北极星指标思路 (EKET 自己承认缺), KALLAX 复用已有 heartbeat 植入激活记录. 写盘 by default, 队列是升级路径. 降级链保证 99.99% 可用.
